notes.title: Your Love Story was nominated by LSA2022 for "Best Vision" and "Best Creativity"
notes.notes:
Thank the sponsor Love Story Project and the players for their support. We are very glad to learn that Your Love Story has been nominated by LSA2022 for "Best Vision" and "Best Creativity".

We will try our best to create works that can make players love and satisfied.

OceanPanda Studio
Jin&Ming

notes.title: 《Your Love Story被你忘记的那个夏天》繁体中文版更新
notes.notes:
The traditional Chinese version of “Your Love Story” was updated on August 26. At the same time, the use of some punctuation marks has been optimized, and we hope you can get a more comfortable game experience.

Any further questions or suggestions, please feel free to contact us or join our QQ group (367369942) for discussion.

Thank you for your attention and support!

Oceanpanda studio

notes.title: Patch on August 22, the patch corrected the problem of automatic play
notes.notes:
Patch on August 22, the patch corrected the problem that the automatic playback would stop, and added the fast read and fast memory function.

Thanks for the bug feedback and suggestions from " 凉茶 official", "瞎鸽子", "微笑向暖".

Ming&Jin
